## 212. Mutual dependence and the pace it gives (MD1)

**The question.** The opening says that the Earth "has become a highly entangled system", that every country and person "is heavily coupled into it", and that the logic of winning is being trained into the next intelligence "at an exponential pace, which leaves us very little time to react". The note on those sentences had read "entangled" as couplings on loops and shown only that loops are needed for growth beyond every polynomial, not that they are enough. Ren's reply of 19 October ([words](../../../../../../sources/15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-19-entangled-mutual-dependence.md)) agreed that "entangled" should read as mutual dependence or shared conditions, and asked to close the gap. What does mutual dependence state about formations, and what does it give for pace?

**The readings.** `Becoming.Feedback` already has four closures of a formation. Three of them, read as the whole, give three readings of an entangled web. Sharing conditions throughout: every system the whole. Mutual dependence: every influence closure the whole, so every continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other. Mutual feeding: every feeding closure the whole, so every continuation is fed, at some remove, by every other. The order is strict. In the clearer's web every system is the whole, yet the dweller lies beyond the clearer's influence closure, since the dweller exchanges with nothing (`Clearing.shares_not_mutual`). In `Drawing`, a balanced pair each taking from what the other requires with nothing given, each can affect the other while neither feeds the other (`Drawing.mutual_not_fed`). `Overshoot`, where each feeds the other's condition, is mutually fed (`Overshoot.mutuallyFed`). Mutual dependence is the reading that fits "entangled". Sharing a condition does not entangle two formations that never affect each other (`Static.shares_unaffected` is the bare case), and mutual feeding asks that the entanglement be one of support, while `Drawing` is a race. Influence and reach are converse (`Flow.withinInfluence_iff_withinReach`, an instance of `WithinClosure.converse` of `Becoming.Response`). So a flow is mutually dependent exactly where every reach closure is the whole (`Flow.mutuallyDependent_iff_reach`): whatever a formation affects can affect it back, and every link of affecting lies on a loop through the whole. That was the content of the loop reading, now stated between formations.

**Where it meets significance.** Under each reading, significance bounded by the matching closure, the system, the influence closure or the feeding closure of each center, is the continuation condition (`Flow.SharesThroughout.unrestricted`, `Flow.MutuallyDependent.unrestricted`, `Flow.MutuallyFed.unrestricted`). The last extends `Flow.feeding_unrestricted_of_common`, which needed one condition that every formation requires and gives to at one step, to any web of mutual feeding. The opening's sentence "whoever counts all that feeds its own continuation already counts what the one step counts" therefore holds wherever continuations feed one another at some remove, not only around one shared condition. That the actual Earth is so stays a judgment.

**Pace.** The condition-level laws of `Becoming.Frequency` give pace for couplings with given strengths. Couplings holding at every step advance a chain one coupling a step (`CoupledAlways.chainInTime`). So a loop of m + 1 of them returns what reached its condition every m + 1 steps (`returns_of_coupledAlways`), and by `carried_returns` each return at least doubles it. After R turns the most difference that can arrive there is at least 2^R times what had reached it (`carried_pow_around`), and likewise at any condition downstream along couplings holding at every step (`carried_pow_downstream`). With the part giving no gap after the start, starting gaps at most D and strengths into each condition at most M, the same amount is at most D·(1 + M)^t whatever the couplings (`carried_le_pow_always`, `carried_le_count` with every step marked). Around such a loop it is exponential both ways (`exponential_around`). Where every listed condition is coupled at every step into every listed condition (`CoupledThroughout`), the lower bound holds from every condition to every condition (`CoupledThroughout.exponential`). The lower bounds are of the carried amount, which a law that takes nothing attains. Under the first law a finite whole to which the rest gives nothing net stays within its stock (`Flow.whole_bounded_of_rest_idle`), so amounts do not grow so without a source beyond.

**The pace of a selection.** `share_rises` compares one generation with the next. Iterated with transmission, carriers leaving at least a offspring and the others at most b, the carriers grow at least as a^n (`carriers_grow`), the others at most as b^n (`others_bounded`), and the ratio of carriers to others at least as (a/b)^n (`share_ratio_pow`). This is the exponential pace of a capture, while the world stays open; enclosed, the descent stops (`Flow.descent_exhausted`).

**Little time.** Under balance, with nothing given to a condition across a stretch, what stands and what has been drawn add up to the starting stock (`Flow.Balances.level_add_drawn`). Where each step's draw exceeds everything drawn before it, as a doubling draw does, more than half the starting stock stands at every step at which the draw is met (`Flow.Balances.half_stands`). Lasting n steps needs a stock of at least 2^n − 1 (`Flow.Balances.doubling_needs`, through `pow_le_drawnBefore`). `DoublingDraw` attains both: draws of 1, 2 and 4 on a stock of 7 leave 4 at the third step and nothing after (`DoublingDraw.half_then_none`). Read with `Web.break_not_bounded`, what stands gives no warning, and doubling the stock buys one step.

**What would change it.** A reading of "entangled" that neither mutual dependence nor its two neighbours captures; a law joining a dependence to a coupling by level with a strength derived, not supplied, which would join the two halves of this item; the pace laws with real strengths or continuous time; a selection whose transmission is noisy.

**Self-review.** The readings are definitions and their order is proved both ways, with witnesses, so the reading is a choice among exact structures and not a verdict encoded in one. The lower bounds hold for every σ, the upper bound for σ = 0, and `exponential_around` states both at σ = 0. `half_stands` uses the first law at the condition: with nothing given, what is taken never exceeds what stands, so "met" is automatic and the law says something about every step of the stretch. No theorem says that mutual dependence makes couplings act; that join is named as supplied.
